cover_letter:
Dear Stijn,

I am excited to apply for the Performance Marketeer role at Introw. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, GEO, and web analytics, I am drawn to Introw's mission of transforming partnerships into revenue engines. Your focus on turning paid spend and buyer intent into qualified pipeline resonates with my own approach to marketing: data-driven, results-oriented, and always learning.

In my current role at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and I write keyword-targeted content that grows organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Ads. This hands-on experience has taught me the importance of lead quality over vanity metrics—a principle I see reflected in your job description.

On my own project, mirook.com, I have applied structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project has honed my ability to turn data into actionable insights and to build things from scratch—skills I am eager to bring to Introw.

I am comfortable with tools like GTM, GA4, and Looker Studio, and I am eager to deepen my expertise in LinkedIn Ads, ABM, and Clay. I am a quick learner and a builder at heart: I take ownership, move fast, and am not afraid to experiment.

I am passionate about partnerships, marketing, and technology, and I believe Introw is at the forefront of an exciting shift in B2B go-to-market strategy. I would love to contribute to your growth journey.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can help Introw turn spend and signals into pipeline.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · Performance Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Performance Marketing: Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Looker Studio (growing)

- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
